protocol.boundary: Actual fact/fact/neutral prefix; clear trace and warm state before query; hold only the witnessed bank. Fixed addresses select latest named A/B records. Query/read ports remain live in one qualified settle. Cortex prefix states may differ between variants.

budget.deadline: Between bounded training rounds and evaluation panels; preserve capped/unrun cells and any final bounded-panel overrun. No paid run.

protocol.custody: Hash parameters/optimizer before and after each trial; hash occupied query drive, raw keys/values/held/ages/ports/amplitude/targets separately from the intentionally different empty_anchor flag. Hash free/positive/negative states and residual/work without additional solves. Capture failed phase state/drive/bank/held.any/prefix before rollback.
protocol.freeze: Commit protocol and every executed dependency before the sole campaign; receipt records actual source revision and hashes. Freeze preservation is checked again at the end.

gate.anchored: Both founders complete all512 rounds, with zero teaching/action refusals; final trained48 cases all answered and exact-pair/slot/unequal/query accuracy >=.95. Source parameters/optimizer preserved by evaluation.
gate.control: Masked must reproduce historical failures; all overlapping occupied-query phase identities must hold.
gate.held_out: Report16 held-out cases separately; they are not an acquisition floor or evidence of generalization.

protocol.intervention: One opt-in empty-bank equation change only: retain E=sum_h alpha_h/2*||r_h||^2 on empty streams instead of held.any masking; alpha=1.5/head. Every nonempty memory/teacher force is unchanged. Legacy masked is the control.
protocol.matching: On overlapping completed rounds with qualified prefixes require identical before/after parameters+optimizer, occupied query drive/bank, actual query decisions, selected rows, and teacher phase records. Prefix neural states/decisions are allowed to differ. Masked training/work/final parameter digest must reproduce retained founder0/1 prefix refusals after42/21 rounds.
protocol.schedule: heads_admission.task.draw(founder,512,16), SeedSequence([622022,founder]); same frozen draws and initialization per variant.
protocol.scope: Matched development repair of supplied-content multi-output acquisition/qualified settling on the existing H2 fixed-address oracle anatomy. No learned selection, H1/H2 comparison, semantic or integrated-life claim.
protocol.stop: One repaired variant only. No numerical retry, force/cap grid, fresh founders, best checkpoint or H comparison. All failed/refused/capped arms stay in the denominator. Confirmation blocks200..219 and300..319 remain unopened.
protocol.teaching: Exact existing normalized wrong-pair-row teacher; both final labels, beta/2 per slot, original momentum/RMS. No per-slot teacher or address lesson.
